points.description: States that the testing stage influences the coding stage (phase 5).
points.partial_credit: Half credit if coding is identified but the phase is vaguely described (e.g. 'implementation' without naming coding) — only if clearly precise otherwise; otherwise none.

points.description: States that the testing stage influences the solution refinement stage (phase 7).
points.partial_credit: Half credit if refinement is identified but loosely worded (e.g. 'improving the solution') with the correct sense.

points.description: Gives exactly these two stages and no wrong extra stages (e.g. not design, requirements, maintenance, deployment as influenced stages).

rubric.notes: Full marks require both stages named precisely: coding (phase 5) and solution refinement (phase 7). Naming only one earns at most its own point; vague talk about 'fixing bugs' without naming the stage earns nothing. Any wrong extra stage listed loses the final point, and an answer naming neither stage earns 0.
